issue.title: lint_and_test.md: uv run pytest after just install clobbers the locally built sase_core_rs extension
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1h7.4 note #5 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP), triaged by the sase-1h7 land agent.

During sase-1h7.4, `uv run pytest` after `just install` re-synced the venv from `uv.lock`
(which pins the published `sase-core-rs` 0.35.x). That replaced the locally built
`sase_core_rs` 0.37.0 wheel built from the linked sase-core checkout, so new bindings
(`wait_epic_follow_reduce`) vanished and tests failed for reasons unrelated to the change.
`.venv/bin/python -m pytest` or `just test-scoped` keep the locally built extension.

`sase/memory/lint_and_test.md` documents `just install` / `just test` / `sase tool run`,
but not this trap. Agents verifying sase-core binding work keep rediscovering it.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Add a one-line gotcha: after just install (or just rust-install) never verify with uv run pytest, because uv run re-syncs uv.lock's published sase-core-rs and replaces the locally built extension; use .venv/bin/python -m pytest, just test-scoped, or sase tool run instead.

issue.creation_reason: sase-1h7.4 lost time when uv run re-synced uv.lock over the locally built sase_core_rs wheel, hiding new bindings; the lint/test memory does not warn about it.
